post_title: NVIDIA-Meta AI infra deal deploys millions of GPUs, Grace CPUs

sections.title: NVIDIA-Meta Deploy Millions of Blackwell and Rubin GPUs with First Large-Scale Grace CPUs
sections.lead: NVIDIA and Meta announced a multiyear partnership on February 17, 2026, covering on-premises, cloud, and AI infrastructure.

sections.title: SemiAnalysis InferenceX v2 Shows NVIDIA GB300 Delivers 100x H100 Inference Performance
sections.lead: SemiAnalysis released InferenceX v2 on February 16, 2026 — an open-source suite benchmarking AI inference across leading hardware platforms.

sections.title: Western Digital Sold Out of Hard Drives for All of 2026, Long-Term Agreements Extend to 2028
sections.lead: Western Digital reported all 2026 hard drives sold out due to surging AI data center demand, with long-term agreements extending into 2027–2028.

sections.title: SpaceX Acquires xAI to Deploy One Million Solar-Powered Orbital Data Centers
sections.lead: SpaceX announced the acquisition of xAI to form a vertically integrated "innovation engine," deploying solar-powered orbital data centers to bypass terrestrial power limits.

sections.title: NVIDIA Teases World-Surprising Chips at GTC 2026 — Rubin GPUs with HBM4 Expected
sections.lead: Jensen Huang announced major processors to "surprise the world" at GTC 2026 (March 16–19), likely Rubin GPUs with HBM4 following talks with SK Hynix.

sections.title: OpenAI Reportedly Building AI Smart Speaker with Camera for 2027 Release [Unverified]
sections.lead: Reports indicate OpenAI assembled a 200-person team for AI-powered devices, starting with a $200–300 camera-equipped smart speaker slated for 2027 release.

sections.title: CPU Supercycle, China's 6x Power Advantage, and Hardware Shortages — Three Structural Infrastructure Trends
sections.lead: February 2026 confirms three simultaneous structural trends reshaping AI infrastructure competition.
